DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome secondary to Lung Cancer.

The combination of a 2.5 cm right upper lobe mass, severe hypoalbuminemia (implied by 4+ protein and fatty casts), and hyperlipidemia strongly suggests paraneoplastic glomerulonephritis or direct tumor invasion causing nephrotic syndrome.
